findings.message: The email is interpolated into the SQL string with an f-string, so a crafted email value can inject arbitrary SQL. This also breaks the repository rule requiring parameterised SQL.
findings.suggestion: row = connection.execute("SELECT id, email, name FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone()

findings.message: This adds new behaviour (`find_by_email`) without a test, but the contributing guide requires a test for every behaviour change.
